descriptor.retrieval_description: Elongated rectangular cardboard box with a dry, matte surface and flat planar sides meeting at distinct vertical edges. The intended contact region on the lateral faces is clean, uniform, and interrupted by vertical box seams.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing side faces of the rectangular box
descriptor.local_geometry: Flat planar faces meeting at distinct vertical edges, with vertical corner seams
descriptor.uncertainty: The rear faces and internal contents are not visible, but the primary grasp surfaces are fully exposed.
